description: Deterministic candidate suggestions joining the 275-slot Prayer Art Matching Map to 22 user-approved primary painting identities. Subject fits are preliminary; original identity approval never implies approval for every matched slot or a certified source photo.
safeguards: No modifications to source placement registry or source painting master
No use of workbook illustrative examples as candidate selections
No inferential reuse of a painting-specific approval as a slot approval
No released image URLs; no upload or production activation
No inferred full-image rights, native QA, photo crop or visual approval
Excluded Fra Angelico and El Greco remain excluded
Zero paid source or storage required
Multi-slot reuse refers back to a single stable artwork ID
scope_limitations: Only 22 explicitly approved primary artworks included; the wider 383-record gallery is not yet joined
Subject tags are provisional curatorial classification requiring slot-specific editorial review
Candidate pool counts are not image availability or publication readiness
